title: Herbaceous Bengali Chickpeas Paratha
description: Salty, chewy parathas filled with spiced chickpeas and fresh herbs, perfect for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Rinse and drain canned chickpeas, then mash slightly with a fork.
In a bowl, mix mashed chickpeas with fajita seasoning, turmeric, salt, chopped cilantro, mint, and minced chili.
In another bowl, whisk together whole wheat flour, water, and 1 tablespoon oil until a soft dough forms.
Divide dough into 8 equal portions, rolling each into a ball.
Flatten a dough ball into a small disc, spoon 2 tablespoons of chickpea filling onto the center, then fold edges over to seal.
Gently roll the stuffed disc into a paratha shape, about 6 inches in diameter.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat, adding the remaining tablespoon of oil.
Place the paratha on the skillet, cooking for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and puffed.
Remove from skillet and place on a paper towel to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with a side of yogurt or pickles.
